reason:
Verified by driving all thirteen states. The rendering half of the finding is accurate and the rest is not.

WHAT IS TRUE. .b-switch renders on exactly five states - owner-flight, owner-editing, owner-undone, owner-empty and publish - and on none of the seven guest or artifact states (phone, desk, day, print, unfurl, ended, loading, loading-slow all return no .b-switch). owner-empty does print 'Aisling & Tom ONE OF THREE'. The fixture holds PROJECT + 2 SIBLINGS = 3, so the count is correct and the seat's arithmetic (F.siblings.length + 1) matches. The gate does not assert anything about this string (interaction-check.mjs:2270 only tests name identity, 2544 only tests border 0 / radius 0), so this is not a gate restatement.

WHY IT FAILS. (1) The ordinal reading is asserted, never demonstrated, and the artifact's own grammar argues against it. Every counter in this master is set in FIGURES - 'BEHIND YOU 3 moments', the .num spans in the undo bar, the day count. This is the one place a number is spelled as a word, and spelling it out is exactly what kills the counter reading: English writes positions as '1 of 3' and partitives as 'one of three'. Its typographic register says the same thing - mono, uppercase, 11px, fore-62 - is the inert-label register that on the very same bar carries 'NOTHING TO PREVIEW YET', a phrase of words, not a counter.

(2) The elided noun is supplied twice, in the two places a reader actually looks. 'The Orchard, events' sits immediately to the left at 1440/1152 and directly on the line ABOVE at 390 - measured, .b-where at [20,20] and .b-switch at [20,47]. The phrase is in apposition to the project name it touches, so 'Mara & Finn, one of three' recovers its own antecedent the way 'Sarah, one of four' does. And the enclosing region is already named 'The plan for Mara & Finn' in the AX tree, so the noun is spoken to a screen reader before this text is reached. Measured off the full CDP AX tree at 1440, the bar reaches assistive tech as three clean StaticText nodes: 'The Orchard, events' / 'Mara & Finn' / 'ONE OF THREE'. No concatenation defect, no missing name.

(3) The audience argument is aimed at the wrong reader. The finding invokes 'the audience for this product has never used a project-management tool' - but that reader is the couple, the families and the venue, and this string appears on no surface any of them ever see. The only person who reads it is the owner, who created the three projects that make the three. They will not need to be told what three counts.

(4) The 'contradiction' is self-cancelling. owner-empty is a different project in a different session; nobody sees both at once. And two projects both labelled 'one of three' is the DISAMBIGUATOR for the partitive, not a contradiction - the ordinal reading needed to manufacture it would require an ordering that nothing on any surface establishes.

(5) THE FIX WOULD MAKE IT WORSE, measured. Setting the label to 'one of three plans' widens it from 100px to 150px. At 768 that wraps the owner-empty bar to a second line - .b-bar height goes 40 -> 63 - because 134 (place) + 252 (switch) + 184 ('NOTHING TO PREVIEW YET') plus gaps overruns the 576px measure. It also seats a countable 'plans' on the same component that renders 'Back to the plan' as its only action in the publish state, and under a region already named 'The plan for ...'. Round 7 stripped this element's chrome so that the bar would read 'the place, then the project, then the actions'; hanging a plural noun off it lengthens the quietest line on the highest-traffic screen to say something its two neighbours already say.

(6) The hardcoded-literal point is true but inert. F.siblings.length + 1 === 3, so no rendered pixel is wrong today, no reader can ever see the difference, and the proposed remedy invents a new fixture formatter (F.fmt.word for 2-9) whose entire job is to spell one word. That is machinery bought for nothing and cannot move a score at 9.5.

What is left after the verified parts are removed is a preference for explicit over elliptical copy, stated as a defect. Refuted.
sharpenedFix: If anything is worth doing here it is only the invisible hygiene half, and only if it is free: derive the word from the accessor rather than typing it, without touching the rendered string. Do not add the noun - it is already carried by the workspace name beside it and by the region name above it, and adding it wraps the owner-empty bar at 768.
